implementation_summary: Marker (pendingDirectInviteStorage.ts): value is now the record {inviteeRef,pubkey,declined} (key unchanged). New exports recordPendingDirectInvite, getPendingDirectInviteMarker, markPendingDirectInviteDeclined(groupId,inviteeRef), loadDeclinedPendingDirectInvites, DeclineMarkerStore + pendingDirectInviteMarkerStore. A strict parser ignores legacy values (bare true, no inviteeRef, wrong types) without throwing; the read-modify-write is serialised per key (consume and clear share the chain; no idb-keyval update()). declineDurability.ts: createMarkerRecordingInviter persists inviteeRef->pubkey after an accepted invite (best-effort). createDeclineDurability.onWelcomeDeclined is a synchronous listener: it starts the durable declined write immediately and enqueues the removal on handle.enqueue as its last action; the removal never starts before the write settled and only runs for a marker of that group carrying that exact inviteeRef (unknown ref ignored). The queued job only starts the removal (detached, tracked), which runs through GroupOpQueue.runCommit (bounded abortable synced(), commit-pending retry): inside the op, a member list without the invitee resolves as already-removed, else group.removeMember. Only after it resolved: marker cleared, then one declined announcement (MLS group rumor via the injected announce port) is attempted. A rejected removal keeps the marker declined and announces nothing. startupRetry()/retryDeclined() replay every declined marker; replays are idempotent (marker re-read, per-key in-flight de-duplication, already-removed). Exported through invitations/index.ts. REMEDIATION (post-review): (1) the decline is bound to the invited LEAF: the invite wrapper records leafKey (account leaves after the invite minus those before, only when exactly one); the queued op removes only that leaf (sole leaf -> removeMember; gone -> already-removed; other leaves present -> removeLeaf if the handle has it, else superseded: nothing removed, marker cleared, reported); (2) the marker is re-read inside the runCommit op (declined + same inviteeRef or no-marker) and cleared only by compare-and-clear clearPendingDirectInviteIfRef serialised on the key; (3) phased marker declined -> removing -> announce-pending -> announce -> clear, replays announce without a second Remove; announcement is at-least-once with a stable dedup id (groupId:inviteeRef) in its content; (4) in-session bounded backoff replay (30 s, 2 min, 10 min, abortable) after retry-later/group-missing, retryDeclined exposed for S18; (5) orphan declines persisted (max 50, 7-day TTL, own idb store) and adopted by record() (declined from the start; onRecordedDeclined -> replayMarker enqueues the removal); (6) consumeChains renamed keyChains with an accurate doc, legacy markPendingDirectInvite and the bulk clears routed through the per-key chain, inner process renamed processMarker; (7) test: the same pubkey in two groups, a decline in one leaves the other member and marker untouched.

decisions: Marker writer: recordPendingDirectInvite is ADDED; the legacy markPendingDirectInvite(groupId,pubkey) (bare true) is kept unchanged, because InviteMemberModal, MarmotContext and ~10 legacy tests still use it until the S18 cut-over / S22 sweep. Record-aware readers ignore bare-true markers (AC-DEL-2); the presence-only readers (loadPendingDirectInviteMarkers, consume) still see every key shape.
groupId is not stored in the record (the seam shape stays exactly {inviteeRef,pubkey,declined}); it is derived from the key (the pubkey is hex, so the last colon splits).
A group that is not loaded at retry time keeps the marker declined (outcome group-missing); S13's leave purge clears markers of a left group (clearPendingDirectInvitesForGroup).

The durable declined write starts inside the synchronous listener (an idb write, not a client call) so a once-fired event survives a crash before the queued job; if that write fails the removal is not attempted and the error is reported (the decline is then only retried if the marker was already declined).

The removal job only starts the work (detached, tracked by idle()) so a 30 s bounded synced() wait of one group does not block the serial client job queue. A removal that loses its bounded sync wait (retry-later / group-missing) is replayed in-session with a bounded backoff (30 s, 2 min, 10 min, abortable by dispose) and afterwards only by startupRetry / retryDeclined(); S18 adds the reconnect / group-sync trigger.

Serialisation: consumePendingDirectInviteMarker was refactored onto a shared private serialisedOnKey helper (same behaviour, same chain map) and clearPendingDirectInvite now runs on it, so a mark-declined read-modify-write is never overtaken by a clear and never resurrects a cleared marker. idb-keyval update() is not used.
invitations/index.ts (barrel) was edited although not in scope.includes, as S8/S10 did: other modules import invitations only through the index.
Baseline test count is derived (final minus S11's 41), not separately measured.

Decline bound to the LEAF (sev7): marker gets optional leafKey (derived at invite time from group.leaves(pubkey) after minus before, only when exactly one new leaf; else none recorded). The library MarmotGroup handle exposes no removeLeaf (only the device service does), so DeclineGroup has an OPTIONAL removeLeaf; without it a declined leaf next to other leaves of the account is NOT removed (marker cleared as 'superseded', reported via onError). removeMember is used only when the declined leaf is the account's sole leaf; with no leafKey recorded the account is removed only when it holds exactly one leaf.

Residual: removeMember removes every leaf the account holds WHEN THE COMMIT IS BUILT; a leaf added between the member-list check and the build would go too (library semantics, not preventable at this layer).

Marker re-read inside the queued op after synced(); clear is compare-and-clear (clearPendingDirectInviteIfRef, store.clearIfRef) on inviteeRef, serialised on the key, so a re-invite's new marker is never cleared by an old decline. store.clear is no longer part of DeclineMarkerStore.

Phased marker (marker shape: optional phase): declined -> removing (before removeMember/removeLeaf) -> announce-pending (after it resolved) -> announce -> clear. A replay with 'removing' and the declined leaf gone, or 'announce-pending', announces without a Remove; 'removing' with the leaf still present removes again; plain 'declined' with the leaf gone is already-removed (clear, no announcement: indistinguishable from a foreign removal).

Announcement is AT-LEAST-ONCE (supersedes the earlier at-most-once decision): a failing send keeps announce-pending and is retried; a crash between send and clear (or a failing clear) re-sends. Content = {type:'invite_lifecycle', event:'declined', pubkey, id:'<groupId>:<inviteeRef>'} (declinedDedupId) so a receiver can de-duplicate. AC-DECL-1 'exactly one announcement' therefore holds per decline id: exactly one in the normal path, a duplicate with the SAME id after a crash/clear failure. Receiver-side dedupe is an S18/S19 follow-up: parseStructured currently drops the extra id field.

In-session backoff (DEFAULT_RETRY_DELAYS_MS 30 s, 2 min, 10 min; deps.retryDelaysMs, [] disables) after retry-later / group-missing, abortable by dispose, per marker key; any externally started replay (event, startupRetry, retryDeclined) resets the count. After the bound only startupRetry / retryDeclined replay it: S18 should call retryDeclined on reconnect / group sync.

Orphan declines (sev4): markPendingDirectInviteDeclined on an unknown ref persists {groupId, inviteeRef, receivedAt} in its own idb store 'few-pending-invite-orphans' (max 50 newest, 7-day TTL) and the listener reports it via onError; record() consumes a matching unexpired orphan and starts declined (returns the marker); createMarkerRecordingInviter.onRecordedDeclined (wire to DeclineDurability.replayMarker) enqueues the removal. Orphans are cleared by clearPendingDirectInvitesForGroup / clearAllPendingDirectInvites.

Serialisation: consumeChains renamed keyChains. Serialised per key: consume, clear, legacy markPendingDirectInvite, record, mark-declined, setPhase, clearIfRef, clearPendingDirectInvitesForGroup (per key), clearAllPendingDirectInvites (per key, then the whole store dropped). Unserialised by design: pure readers (snapshots; every decision re-reads inside the chain) and the final whole-store clear of the account wipe. Inner function process renamed processMarker.
architecture.md marker seam text (PendingDirectInviteMarker) updated for leafKey, phase and the new invariants.
Baseline test count is derived (final minus S11's added tests), not separately measured.

Terminal removal errors: a removeMember/removeLeaf/synced rejection classified by isTerminalRemovalError (MarmotError code not-a-member, invalid-options with details.reason not-admin, or the codes/reasons not-admin, member-not-found, group-disbanded, disbanded, abandoned) can never succeed on retry: the marker is compare-and-cleared (clearIfRef), the error reported once, the outcome is 'terminal' and no backoff replay is scheduled. Every other rejection stays retry-later.

Maximum marker age: declined markers carry declinedAt (stamped when the decline is recorded; the orphan's arrival time when adopted). A replay that finds now - declinedAt > DECLINED_MARKER_MAX_AGE_MS (30 days, the library's DEFAULT_INVITE_RETENTION_MS) compare-and-clears the marker, reports it and returns 'expired' without a removal. Markers without declinedAt are not aged out.

Stale orphans: createMarkerRecordingInviter reads invitedAt (injectable now) before the invite and record() adopts an orphan decline only when orphan.receivedAt >= invitedAt; an older orphan of the same ref belongs to an earlier invite and is deleted unadopted, so a fresh invite is never born declined.

onRecordedDeclined is required on createMarkerRecordingInviter (validated at construction): an adopted orphan decline without a handler would silently leave the member in the group. A marker whose stored phase is outside PHASES is invalid (ignored, reported by the declined listing), never coerced to 'declined'.
limitations: Not wired into production: S18 must wrap the inviter with createMarkerRecordingInviter (replacing the legacy markPendingDirectInvite call; pass the REQUIRED onRecordedDeclined: durability.replayMarker), route clientEvents.welcomeDeclined to onWelcomeDeclined, call startupRetry() once after bootstrap and retryDeclined() on reconnect / group sync, bind announce to the S6 sender (kind 9) and getGroup to client.groups.get, and dispose the instance with the handle.
e2e halves of AC-DECL-1 (groups-direct-invite-lifecycle, groups-invite-lifecycle-announcements) run in S24-S26.
The cancel-invitation path (S14) and the account wipe (S17) must clear markers through clearPendingDirectInvite / clearAllPendingDirectInvites; S11 does not touch them.

A declined leaf next to other leaves of the same account is not removed until the library handle exposes a leaf-level remove (DeclineGroup.removeLeaf is used if present): the marker is cleared as 'superseded' and reported.
Receiver-side de-duplication of the declined announcement on its id is not implemented (S18/S19 follow-up); until then a crash between send and clear can show a duplicate post.
